subject: package manager
text: The package manager is pnpm 9; do not use npm or yarn in this repo.

subject: node version
text: Node version is pinned to 20.11 in .nvmrc; run nvm use before installing.

subject: monorepo
text: The monorepo is orchestrated with Turborepo; pipelines live in turbo.json.

subject: env files
text: Never commit .env files; only .env.example is tracked.

subject: env setup
text: For local env, copy .env.example to .env.local and pull secrets from the 1Password vault acme-dev.

subject: commits
text: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, chore:).

subject: pull requests
text: Every PR needs one approval from CODEOWNERS and green CI before merge.

subject: ci
text: CI runs on GitHub Actions; workflows are in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

subject: linter
text: Linting and formatting use Biome; run pnpm lint at the root.

subject: eslint
text: Decided to drop ESLint and Prettier in favor of Biome in March.

subject: module system
text: All packages are ESM: package.json has "type": "module".

subject: ERR_REQUIRE_ESM
text: ERR_REQUIRE_ESM fix: set "type": "module" in the package and import with the .js extension instead of require().

subject: path aliases
text: TypeScript path aliases use the @acme/* prefix, defined in tsconfig.base.json.

subject: exports
text: Prefer named exports; no default exports except Next.js pages.

subject: unit tests
text: Unit tests use Vitest across all packages.

subject: e2e tests
text: End-to-end tests use Playwright.

subject: coverage
text: Coverage threshold is 80% lines; CI fails below it.

subject: dependency updates
text: Renovate opens dependency update PRs every Monday; automerge only for patch updates.

subject: versioning
text: Versioning uses Changesets: run pnpm changeset for any user-facing change.

subject: answer style
text: User prefers concise answers with the code first and the explanation after.

subject: lodash
text: Avoid lodash; use native array methods or remeda.

subject: validation
text: Runtime validation uses zod everywhere.

subject: dates
text: Use date-fns for dates; moment is banned.

subject: logging
text: Structured logging uses pino.

subject: error tracking
text: Errors are reported to Sentry; the DSN comes from SENTRY_DSN.

subject: feature flags
text: Feature flags are managed in GrowthBook.

subject: analytics
text: Product analytics use PostHog.

subject: time zone
text: All timestamps are stored in UTC; convert to local time only in the UI.

subject: git hooks
text: Git hooks run through lefthook; husky was removed.

subject: python
text: Python scripts in tools/ use Python 3.12 managed by uv.

subject: sudo
text: Never run pnpm install with sudo; fix permissions instead.

subject: ports
text: Local ports: web 3000, api 4000, worker metrics 9464, Postgres 5432, Redis 6379.

subject: docker
text: Local containers run on OrbStack instead of Docker Desktop.

subject: local services
text: Start Postgres and Redis locally with docker compose up -d db redis.

subject: dev server
text: pnpm dev at the root starts web, api and worker together via Turborepo.

subject: staging
text: Staging is at staging.acme.dev and deploys automatically from main.

subject: production
text: Production deploys happen from git tags v*; the release workflow is release.yml.

subject: main branch
text: Never force-push to main; it is a protected branch.

subject: codeowners
text: The platform team owns infra/ and .github/ in CODEOWNERS.

subject: comments
text: User wants no comments that restate the code; comment only the why.

subject: editor
text: Recommended VS Code extensions are listed in .vscode/extensions.json.

subject: pnpm lockfile
text: Gotcha: CI uses pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, so always commit pnpm-lock.yaml after adding a dependency.

subject: secrets manager
text: Team secrets live in the 1Password vault acme-dev; production secrets are in AWS Secrets Manager.

subject: apple silicon
text: On Apple Silicon, the sharp and canvas packages need Rosetta-free builds: run pnpm rebuild sharp after switching Node versions.

subject: typescript
text: TypeScript runs in strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess enabled.

subject: issue tracker
text: Issues are tracked in Linear under the ACME team; branch names start with the Linear id like acme-123.

subject: console.log
text: Do not leave console.log in committed code; use the pino logger.

subject: license
text: The repo is proprietary; the CLI package is MIT licensed.

subject: package manager
text: The package manager is yarn 1.

subject: node version
text: Node version is 18 LTS.

subject: web framework
text: The web app is Next.js 15 with the App Router.

subject: auth provider
text: The web auth provider is Clerk.

subject: auth provider
text: The web auth provider is Auth0.

subject: auth middleware
text: Clerk middleware lives in apps/web/middleware.ts and protects everything except publicRoutes.

subject: login page
text: The login page is apps/web/app/login/page.tsx and renders Clerk's SignIn component.

subject: redirect loop
text: Gotcha: the sign-in redirect loop happens when /login is missing from publicRoutes in middleware.ts; also set afterSignInUrl to /dashboard.

subject: styling
text: Styling is Tailwind CSS v4; config is CSS-first in app/globals.css.

subject: ui components
text: UI components come from shadcn/ui and live in apps/web/components/ui.

subject: server state
text: Server state uses TanStack Query; client state uses zustand.

subject: redux
text: Decided not to use Redux in the web app.

subject: forms
text: Forms use react-hook-form with zod resolvers.

subject: images
text: Remote images must be allowed in next.config.ts remotePatterns; the CDN host is cdn.acme.dev.

subject: public env vars
text: Only env vars prefixed NEXT_PUBLIC_ are exposed to the browser; never put secrets in them.

subject: web tests
text: Run web unit tests with pnpm --filter web test.

subject: web e2e
text: Run web end-to-end tests with pnpm --filter web e2e; it needs the dev server on port 3000.

subject: storybook
text: Storybook runs on port 6006 with pnpm --filter web storybook.

subject: hydration mismatch
text: Hydration mismatch fix: format dates on the client inside useEffect, or use suppressHydrationWarning on the time element.

subject: i18n
text: Translations use next-intl; messages are in apps/web/messages/*.json.

subject: icons
text: Icons come from lucide-react.

subject: dark mode
text: Dark mode is handled by next-themes with the class strategy.

subject: api client
text: All browser calls to the API go through apps/web/lib/api.ts, a fetch wrapper that sends credentials: include.

subject: analytics provider
text: The PostHog provider is mounted in apps/web/app/providers.tsx.

subject: can't resolve fs
text: Build error "Module not found: Can't resolve 'fs'" fix: add import "server-only" and keep the module out of client components.

subject: preview deploys
text: The web app deploys on Vercel; every PR gets a preview deployment.

subject: caching
text: Marketing pages use ISR with revalidate = 60.

subject: security headers
text: CSP and security headers are set in next.config.ts headers().

subject: fonts
text: The Inter font is loaded with next/font/google in app/layout.tsx.

subject: payments
text: Checkout uses Stripe Checkout redirect; the web app never sees card data.

subject: accessibility
text: Icon-only buttons must have an aria-label.

subject: bundle size
text: Inspect bundle size with ANALYZE=true pnpm --filter web build.

subject: route groups
text: Authenticated pages live in the app/(dashboard) route group; public pages in app/(marketing).

subject: server actions
text: Decided to use server actions for form posts instead of API routes in the web app.

subject: error pages
text: Global errors are handled in app/global-error.tsx which reports to Sentry.

subject: components style
text: User prefers small components under 150 lines and colocated tests.

subject: web env
text: The web app reads the API base URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.

subject: clerk keys
text: Gotcha: Clerk dev instance keys start with pk_test_; production builds fail if pk_test_ keys are used.

subject: web framework
text: The web app is Next.js 13 with the pages router.

subject: api framework
text: The API is built with Fastify 5.

subject: database
text: The database is Postgres 16.

subject: orm
text: The ORM is Drizzle; schema is in apps/api/src/db/schema.ts.

subject: db migrations
text: Apply migrations with pnpm --filter api db:migrate.

subject: generate migration
text: Generate a new migration with pnpm --filter api drizzle-kit generate after editing schema.ts.

subject: api auth
text: The API verifies Clerk session JWTs with @clerk/backend in src/plugins/auth.ts.

subject: rate limit
text: Rate limit is 100 requests per minute per IP, stored in Redis via @fastify/rate-limit.

subject: api versioning
text: Routes are versioned under /v1.

subject: openapi
text: The OpenAPI spec is generated from zod schemas into apps/api/openapi.yaml.

subject: api tests
text: API tests run against a real Postgres started by Testcontainers.

subject: auth tests
text: Run only the auth tests with pnpm --filter api test -- auth.

subject: stripe webhook
text: Gotcha: the Stripe webhook route /v1/webhooks/stripe needs the raw body; register fastify-raw-body or signature verification fails.

subject: error format
text: Errors are returned as RFC 7807 problem+json.

subject: pagination
text: List endpoints use cursor pagination, never offset.

subject: soft delete
text: Rows are soft-deleted with a deleted_at column.

subject: money
text: Money is stored as integer cents, never floats.

subject: ids
text: Primary keys are UUID v7.

subject: connection pool
text: The Postgres pool max is 10 connections per pod.

subject: pgbouncer
text: Gotcha: PgBouncer runs in transaction mode, so prepared statements must be disabled (prepare: false).

subject: database url
text: The API reads the database connection string from DATABASE_URL.

subject: seed data
text: Seed local data with pnpm --filter api db:seed.

subject: email
text: Transactional email is sent through Resend; templates are React Email in apps/api/emails.

subject: jobs
text: The API enqueues background jobs to the worker with BullMQ.

subject: cors
text: CORS allows only origins listed in CORS_ORIGINS.

subject: health check
text: The health endpoint is GET /healthz and checks Postgres and Redis.

subject: request ids
text: Every request log carries a requestId header x-request-id.

subject: timeouts
text: Outbound HTTP calls must set a 10 second timeout.

subject: n+1
text: Gotcha: the orders list had an N+1 query; use the with: relations option in Drizzle to batch.

subject: file uploads
text: File uploads go directly to S3 with presigned URLs from POST /v1/uploads.

subject: search
text: Full-text search uses Postgres tsvector columns, not Elasticsearch.

subject: orm choice
text: Switched from Prisma to Drizzle in May because of cold-start time.

subject: api port
text: The API listens on port 4000 locally.

subject: migrations
text: Never edit a migration that has been merged; add a new one.

subject: multi tenancy
text: Every table has an org_id column and queries must filter by it.

subject: webhooks out
text: Outgoing webhooks are signed with HMAC SHA-256 in the X-Acme-Signature header.

subject: jwt clock skew
text: Gotcha: intermittent 401s came from JWT clock skew; allow 5 seconds of leeway in auth.ts.

subject: database
text: The database is MySQL 8.

subject: api framework
text: The API is built with Express 4.

subject: cli framework
text: The CLI is built with commander.

subject: cli bundler
text: The CLI is bundled with tsup into dist/index.js.

subject: cli package
text: The CLI is published to npm as @acme/cli and the binary is named acme.

subject: cli config
text: The CLI stores its config in ~/.acme/config.json.

subject: cli tests
text: CLI tests use Vitest snapshot tests of stdout.

subject: cli release
text: Release the CLI by merging the Changesets version PR; the publish job runs npm publish --provenance.

subject: node support
text: The CLI must support Node 18 and later; no newer APIs without a fallback.

subject: cli esm
text: The CLI is ESM-only; the ERR_REQUIRE_ESM error from users means they are on an old Node, tell them to upgrade to 18.

subject: cli auth
text: acme login uses the OAuth device code flow and stores the token in the OS keychain via keytar.

subject: cli local run
text: Run the CLI locally with pnpm --filter @acme/cli dev -- <args>.

subject: cli colors
text: Terminal colors use picocolors, not chalk.

subject: cli prompts
text: Interactive prompts use @clack/prompts.

subject: cli output
text: Commands must support --json output for scripting.

subject: cli telemetry
text: CLI telemetry is opt-out with ACME_TELEMETRY=0.

subject: windows paths
text: Gotcha: on Windows, config path joins broke; always use path.join and os.homedir().

subject: cli update check
text: The CLI checks for updates once a day using update-notifier.

subject: cli exit codes
text: Exit code 2 means usage error, 1 means runtime error.

subject: cli link
text: To test the CLI globally, run pnpm --filter @acme/cli build then npm link in packages/cli.

subject: cli framework
text: The CLI is built with yargs.

subject: queue
text: The worker consumes BullMQ queues on Redis 7.

subject: queue names
text: Queue names are email, images, billing-sync and webhooks.

subject: concurrency
text: Worker concurrency is 5 jobs per process.

subject: retries
text: Jobs retry 3 times with exponential backoff starting at 1 second.

subject: scheduled jobs
text: Cron jobs are BullMQ repeatable jobs defined in src/schedules.ts.

subject: sharp alpine
text: Gotcha: sharp fails on the Alpine image; the Dockerfile uses node:20-slim with libvips instead.

subject: dead letter
text: Failed jobs after the last retry move to the dead-letter queue dlq and alert in Slack #alerts.

subject: worker metrics
text: The worker exposes Prometheus metrics on port 9464 at /metrics.

subject: worker dev
text: Run the worker locally with pnpm --filter worker dev; it needs Redis running.

subject: job dashboard
text: Bull Board is mounted at /admin/queues on the worker, behind basic auth.

subject: idempotency
text: Every job handler must be idempotent; use the job id as the idempotency key.

subject: billing sync
text: billing-sync pulls Stripe invoices every 15 minutes.

subject: redis memory
text: Gotcha: Redis ran out of memory because completed jobs were kept; set removeOnComplete: 1000.

subject: worker shutdown
text: The worker drains jobs on SIGTERM with a 30 second grace period.

subject: image jobs
text: Image jobs resize uploads to 3 sizes and write WebP to S3.

subject: worker tests
text: Run worker tests with pnpm --filter worker test; they use an in-memory Redis mock (ioredis-mock).

subject: queue
text: The worker consumes RabbitMQ queues.

subject: iac
text: Infrastructure is Terraform 1.8 in infra/terraform.

subject: terraform state
text: Terraform state lives in the S3 bucket acme-tfstate with a DynamoDB lock table.

subject: cloud region
text: AWS region is us-east-1 for everything.

subject: kubernetes
text: The API and worker run on EKS; the cluster is named acme-prod.

subject: helm
text: Helm charts live in infra/helm, one chart per service.

subject: terraform apply
text: Never run terraform apply from a laptop; only the CI plan/apply workflow applies.

subject: terraform plan
text: Run make plan ENV=staging to see a Terraform plan locally.

subject: k8s secrets
text: Kubernetes secrets come from AWS Secrets Manager through External Secrets Operator.

subject: dns
text: DNS is on Cloudflare; the zone is acme.dev.

subject: monitoring
text: Metrics and logs go to Grafana Cloud; dashboards are in infra/grafana.

subject: alerting
text: Alerts page the on-call through PagerDuty.

subject: kube context
text: Switch kubectl context with aws eks update-kubeconfig --name acme-prod --region us-east-1.

subject: container registry
text: Images are pushed to ECR repositories named acme/<service>.

subject: database hosting
text: Production Postgres is RDS with Multi-AZ; backups are kept for 14 days.

subject: redis hosting
text: Production Redis is ElastiCache.

subject: eks upgrade
text: Gotcha: the EKS 1.29 upgrade broke the ingress; the AWS Load Balancer Controller must be upgraded first.

subject: ingress
text: Ingress uses the AWS Load Balancer Controller with ACM certificates.

subject: infra changes
text: Infra changes need a review from the platform team and a plan output pasted in the PR.

subject: autoscaling
text: The worker scales with KEDA on queue length; the API uses HPA on CPU at 70%.

subject: cost
text: Cost tags: every resource needs the tags team and env.

subject: vpn
text: Access to the prod database goes through Tailscale; no public endpoint.

subject: rds failover
text: RDS failover took 90 seconds in the last game day; the API retries connections for 2 minutes.

subject: iac
text: Infrastructure is Pulumi in TypeScript.

subject: merge policy
text: Never merge pull requests yourself; push to the PR branch and let the user merge.

subject: pr timing
text: Do not open a pull request until the user says the work is ready.

subject: branching
text: Always work on a feature branch; never commit directly on main.

subject: pushing
text: Do not push to the upstream remote without asking first.

subject: verification
text: Before saying a task is done, re-check the work for bugs and security issues.

subject: e2e before pr
text: Test changes end to end before opening a PR, not only unit tests.

subject: explanations
text: Explain things plainly, without jargon.

subject: research depth
text: When asked to research, go deep: read primary sources and cite them.

subject: deletion
text: Do not delete files or branches without confirmation.

subject: friday deploys
text: Never deploy to production on Fridays.

subject: pr size
text: Keep diffs small: one concern per pull request.

subject: new dependencies
text: Ask before adding a new dependency.

subject: generated files
text: Never hand-edit generated files under dist/ or *.gen.ts.

subject: destructive db
text: Do not run destructive database commands (drop, truncate, reset) without asking.

subject: full suite
text: Run the full test suite, not only the changed tests, before pushing.

subject: history rewrite
text: Do not rewrite or squash commits that are already pushed.

subject: summaries
text: End-of-task summaries should be a short bullet list.

subject: plan first
text: Show a plan before large refactors and wait for approval.

subject: git stash
text: Do not use git stash; commit work in progress to the branch instead.

subject: skipped tests
text: Never skip or disable failing tests to make CI green.

subject: github cli
text: Use the gh CLI for GitHub operations.

subject: billing code
text: Do not change billing code without the user's review.

subject: emojis
text: No emojis in code, commits or docs.

subject: commit body
text: Commit messages use the imperative mood with a short body explaining why.

subject: major upgrades
text: Do not bump major versions of dependencies without asking.

subject: script language
text: Prefer TypeScript over JavaScript for new scripts.

subject: secrets in logs
text: Keep secrets and tokens out of logs and error messages.

subject: uncertainty
text: When a fix is uncertain, say so instead of guessing.

subject: docs updates
text: Update the docs/ pages when public behavior changes.

subject: ci benchmarks
text: Do not run long benchmarks on the shared CI runners.
